title: Integrability of the Gaussian first moment
statement: Let $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$ be the standard Gaussian density. The function $x\mapsto x\varphi(x)$ is integrable on $\mathbb R$ with respect to Lebesgue measure.
replaced: Let $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$ be the standard Gaussian density. The function $x\mapsto x\varphi(x)$ is integrable over $\mathbb R$ with respect to Lebesgue measure.
